root.name: ノーフォーク・サザン

relations.text: 主な鉄道上の競合相手はCSXで、両社は同じ地域の多くで事業を行っている
relations.text_en: CSX is the primary rail competitor, and both companies operate throughout much of the same territory

source.label: Norfolk Southern 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Our primary rail competitor is CSX Corporation (CSX); both we and CSX operate throughout much of the same territory.

relations.text: NSとCSXは有限責任会社を通じてConrailを共同で所有し、NSの経済的持分は58%である
relations.text_en: NS and CSX jointly own Conrail through a limited liability company, with NS holding a 58% economic interest

source.label: Norfolk Southern 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Through a limited liability company, we and CSX jointly own Conrail, whose primary subsidiary is CRC. We have a 58 % economic and 50 % voting interest in the jointly-owned entity, and CSX has the remainder of the economic and voting interests.

relations.text: NSはCSXとともにConrailを共同所有し、議決権の持分は50%である
relations.text_en: NS jointly owns Conrail with CSX and holds a 50% voting interest

source.label: Norfolk Southern 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: We have a 58 % economic and 50 % voting interest in the jointly-owned entity, and CSX has the remainder of the economic and voting interests.

relations.text: NSは他の6つの北米鉄道会社とともに、貨車プール会社のTTXを共同で所有している
relations.text_en: NS and six other North American railroads collectively own TTX, a railcar pooling company

source.label: Norfolk Southern 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: We and six other North American railroads collectively own TTX Company (TTX), a railcar pooling company that provides its owner-railroads with standardized fleets of intermodal, automotive, and general use railcars at stated rates.

companies.name: ユニオン・パシフィック

relations.text: 2025年7月28日にユニオン・パシフィックと合併契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: NS entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Union Pacific on July 28, 2025

source.label: Norfolk Southern 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On July 28, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Union Pacific Corporation, a Utah corporation (“Union Pacific”)

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
